about: The go adapter's vocabulary for TEST.no-self-mocking, TEST.no-evasion, TEST.property-seed and TEST.no-test-hooks. Packages are import paths; a call is [package import path, function]. The test-marker names, values and hook phrases are shared with the other adapters in test-hook-patterns.json.

fixes.TEST.no-self-mocking: test the owned code through its public entry point; fake only boundaries
fixes.TEST.no-evasion: make the test run and pass, or record an owner-approved exception
fixes.TEST.property-seed: give quick.Config a Rand built from a fixed seed
fixes.TEST.no-test-hooks: remove the hook; tests must exercise the production path unchanged
